sources.revision: OpenCADStudio v2026.42 tag/source commit b6fbac3 and its tagged manifests; OpenCADKernel commit a60f18ff033b5a3f7d842e2398f393e4d6cfcd32; separate tessellation and automation documentation inspected 2026-10-20 and treated as mutable where not tag-pinned. sources.observed: The v2026.42 dependency graph pins opencadcodec/acadrust at 5d4f11ae38758caec540bc9819ff2c4120eeadb4, OpenCADKernel at a60f18ff033b5a3f7d842e2398f393e4d6cfcd32, and OpenCADGraph at d9f2aee. Current separate tessellation notes describe kernel-first handling of Solid3D/Region/Body/Surface plus a per-surface fallback that marks incomplete output; that behavior is not asserted for the tagged release binary. Project self-audit/reopen uses the application's own codec lineage.

sources.revision: BRL-CAD 7.46.0 release and live issue/PR pages inspected 2026-10-20; no BRL-CAD source build or executable run.
sources.observed: The dxf-g route is a geometry converter for explicit DXF mesh/facet input, not a whole-document or ACIS/AcDs route. Issue #228 and proposed PR #245 remain open in the inspected GitHub snapshot. The PR description admits only positive in-range face corner indices, while the DXF POLYFACE encoding uses signed corner indices for invisible-edge state and zero terminators.
sources.limits: Issue/PR descriptions are not a tested release result or format authority. The exact 7.46.0 converter behavior was not executed. Do not use this peer with malformed input or treat its proposed check as a local parser rule.
